Check Define-XML Against Dataset Contents

Source: R/define_consistency.R
check_define_consistency.Rd

Compares the variables declared in Define-XML against the variables actually present in the datasets, and emits evidence for each: a match, a variable documented in Define but absent from the data, or a variable present in the data but not documented. Drift between Define-XML and the data is a common submission problem that reviewers notice quickly, and this makes it a scored indicator. The comparison is case-insensitive on dataset and variable names.

Usage

check_define_consistency(
  define,
  data,
  ctx,
  source_name = "define_vs_data",
  source_version = NULL
)

Arguments

define

Either a path to a Define-XML file, or a data.frame with dataset and variable columns (as returned by define_variables()).

data

A data.frame with dataset and variable columns listing the variables actually present in each dataset.

ctx

A r4sub_run_context.

source_name, source_version

Provenance recorded on the evidence.

Value

A data.frame conforming to the evidence schema, one row per variable checked, under indicator Q-DEFINE-CONSIST.

See also

define_variables(), define_xml_to_evidence().

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(r4sub_run_context("STUDY1", "DEV"))
define <- data.frame(
  dataset  = c("ADSL", "ADSL", "ADSL"),
  variable = c("USUBJID", "AGE", "SEX")
)
data <- data.frame(
  dataset  = c("ADSL", "ADSL", "ADSL"),
  variable = c("USUBJID", "AGE", "RACE")  # SEX missing, RACE undocumented
)
ev <- suppressMessages(check_define_consistency(define, data, ctx))
ev[, c("asset_id", "result", "message")]
#>   asset_id result
#> 1     ADSL   pass
#> 2     ADSL   pass
#> 3     ADSL   fail
#> 4     ADSL   fail
#>                                                             message
#> 1                            ADSL.USUBJID is documented and present
#> 2                                ADSL.AGE is documented and present
#> 3     ADSL.SEX is documented in Define-XML but absent from the data
#> 4 ADSL.RACE is present in the data but not documented in Define-XML
